description: Zac Martin's plain-language guide to the four constitutional amendments on South Dakota's November 3, 2026 ballot. How he is voting on each, why, the other side's best argument, and how District 32's current lawmakers voted to put them there.

title: Your 2026 Ballot: Vote YES on Amendments I, J, K and L. Zac Martin for SD House 32
